description: Land Acquisition - Kohuwala, Dehiwala D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically declaring that certain described lands are needed for public purpose and will be acquired. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land lots, their boundaries, extents, and locations. While it mentions a minister's name and title, the core content focuses entirely on land matters rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
